source: Expected output naming of /tmp/luxury-ux-review-sheets.py (sha256 a58df8bf1d286947b687dfa364cdbb7d5335feb29d031a67bd8d6e2a60ac2da1); bind to the actual completed capture manifest before use.
requiredBeforeReview: Verify completed unrestricted 130-route/260-view capture and source commit; no sampled or incomplete capture is eligible.
Bind this plan to the actual sheet-manifest SHA and verify exact 90-file set; if it differs, regenerate allocation before claiming coverage.
Read every assigned sheet image. A file listing, generated HTML index, successful command or machine check is not a human review.
Keep scaled overview coverage separate from actual native PNG or crop inspections. Confirm suspicious details against the native original.
Save one reviewer receipt using the companion schema. Aggregate actual viewed SHA sets, never the planned counts.

aggregateAcceptance.nativeDetailCoverage: Only the exact native files and regions enumerated by reviewer receipts; no whole-site pixel-perfect claim.
aggregateAcceptance.missingOrBlockedItems: Explicitly list unread sheets/regions and unresolved findings; do not mark global visual acceptance while required sheet coverage is missing.

sheetHashBinding: Sheet SHA/dimensions copied from completed generated manifest; final coverage validator rehashes the originals and sheets.
